illustration.description: Two side-profile views of a standing adult man in a glowing orange anatomical x-ray style. Both figures have dark translucent bodies with bright orange rim lighting and a visible glowing yellow spinal column with distinct vertebrae. The left figure has a forward head posture: the head juts forward, the neck is craned, and the upper back is rounded. The right figure stands upright with a neutral head position, aligned over the shoulders, with a straight spine. Smooth digital medical-illustration style, soft outer glow, dark charcoal-brown bodies, bright orange and yellow highlights, plain white studio background, even lighting.

graphics.description: Thick orange arrow pointing left above the right figure's head, with a tail that fades to transparent toward the right (motion blur gradient).
Thick orange arrow pointing right between the two figures, with a tail that fades to transparent toward the left (motion blur gradient).
Curved dotted line in red-orange following the curvature of the left figure's rounded back, dots decreasing in size from top to bottom, indicating poor posture.
Thin vertical dotted line in green running along the back of the right figure, dots decreasing in size from top to bottom, indicating corrected posture.
